mutants.new:

mutants.old: double get_abs_value(double ratio_over) const { return this->percent ? (ratio_over * this->value / 100) : this->value; }
mutants.new: double get_abs_value(double ratio_over) const { return this->value; }

mutants.old: inline bool operator==(const FloatOrPercent& l, const FloatOrPercent& r) throw() { return is_approx(l.value, r.value) && l.percent == r.percent; }
mutants.new: inline bool operator==(const FloatOrPercent& l, const FloatOrPercent& r) throw() { return is_approx(l.value, r.value) && l.percent != r.percent; }
